name: routed-dialog
title: Dialog roteado
description: Dialog with its own URL for Parallel + Intercepting Routes: opens over a list without unmounting it, zooming out of the row or card it came from (View Transitions) and back on close. Full screen on the Celular, a large centred panel from md up. Closes on the browser and Android back, Esc, click outside and swipe down; navigating inside swaps only the content, with history. Same content as a full page (RoutedPage) for direct access and F5. Asks before discarding unsaved changes.
